question: Where was the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) Intelligence & Investigations (I&I) Workshop hosted by NADA India held?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• NADA India hosts WADA’s Global Anti-Doping Intelligence & Investigations Network Workshop in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**NADA India**, with the **Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports**, hosted the **WADA I&I Workshop** in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The workshop is part of WADA’s **Capability and Capacity Building Project**.

 
 
• 
 
It aims to build the **Global Anti-Doping Intelligence and Investigations Network (GAIIN)**.

 
 
• 
 
Experts from around the world joined to **share knowledge** and **strengthen global cooperation**.

 
 
• 
 
**WADA** stands for **World Anti-Doping Agency**.

 
 
• 
 
It is a **not-for-profit foundation under Swiss law**, created in **1999**.

 
 
• 
 
It was established by the **International Olympic Committee (IOC)** and **governments worldwide**.

 
 
• 
 
WADA’s **Headquarters** is in **Montreal, Canada**.

 
 
• 
 
Its **legal seat** is in **Lausanne, Switzerland**.

 
 
• 
 
The goal of WADA is to **promote clean sport globally** through collaboration and investigations.
